description: envite consulting publishes Camunda Carbon Reductor, a connector that delays eligible workflow tasks to times with cleaner electricity while respecting configured service-level targets. Its README describes versions for Camunda 8 connectors and Camunda 7 external task workers, plus measurement and time-shifting modes. Users give task deadlines and grid-carbon signals; outputs are execution timing and reported carbon estimates for the workflows they configure. Geographic coverage depends on the electricity region and task deployment. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing. A limitation is that a delayed task may shift load, not reduce total energy, and carbon savings depend on forecast accuracy and the grid intensity series used. It can inform energy-aware scheduling scenarios for data centres and digital services. The related Brightway catalogue platform models life cycles, not operating workflow queues. No process configuration, grid feed or package was downloaded.
name: Camunda Carbon Reductor workflow scheduler
